name: makeitship
description: Put work on your Makeitship board as tasks — for you, for your agent, or for the Makeitship team — and follow it, from the agent you already use.

interface.shortDescription: Track work on your Makeitship board as tasks
interface.longDescription: Create well-formed tasks from a conversation on your Makeitship board — for you, for your agent, or for the Makeitship team — read the board by its statuses and reply on tasks, take a task through to done with its Development Insights, and bring engineering skills (testing, exploratory UI QA, design directions, idle CPU and page speed audits, security audits, decision review, implementation docs) that work in any repository — from Codex.
